name: @lit-core/html-minifier
description: High-performance native Rust AOT AST HTML & SVG template minifier for Lit via OXC

scripts.build: cargo build --release && cp target/release/libhtml_minifier.dylib html-minifier.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:debug: cargo build && cp target/debug/libhtml_minifier.dylib html-minifier.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || true
